highlights.description: Status reports: each role files what it finished, what is blocked and on whom, what it does next, and the decisions it needs
`plexushive brief` gathers every report into one briefing: decisions first, then blockers, then each role's status and who has not reported

added.description: `Report`, `Item`, `Blocker`, `DecisionRequest` and `Option` types with validation; a decision request's recommendation must name one of at least two options
`ValidateReports` checks reports against the roles: one per role, no retired roles, and blockers that wait on a role or the operator
`WriteReport`, `LoadReports` and `ReportsDir`: one atomically replaced report per role in `$HIVE_REPORTS` or the per-user data directory
`NewBriefing` gathers reports into decisions, blockers, status and missing roles
`report submit` command, filling the role from `HIVE_ROLE` and the time from the clock, and `brief` command with `--json` output

changed.description: The role name `operator` is reserved for blockers that wait on the operator

documentation.description: Status reports in the README, user guide, CLI reference and a new reference page

tests.description: Tests for reports, the report store, briefings and the new commands, kept out of the real per-user data directory

highlights.description: Roles, decisions and a message envelope as JSON for coordinating long-lived coding agents, with Go types as the source of truth
Repository stewardship: several roles may work in a repository, at most one stewards it, and organization patterns are supported
`plexushive` CLI to validate a hive directory, list the roles working in a repository and print the JSON Schemas

added.description: `Role` format with status, mission, autonomy (`observe`, `prepare`, `execute`), repository affinities, initiatives and peers
`Decision` format for an append-only decision log, with alternatives and supersede links validated in both directions
Message `Envelope` with `Format` and `Parse` for `question`, `request`, `status` and `decision-needed` messages
`RolesFor` and `Steward` resolve the roles that work in a repository, steward first
`Load` reads a hive directory strictly, and `Hive.Validate` checks roles and decisions together
JSON Schemas for roles and decisions generated from the Go types

documentation.description: README covering roles, stewardship, decisions and the envelope
User guide covering roles, sessions, decisions, validation and messages
Documentation site with installation, quick start, user guide and reference for roles, decisions, messages, the CLI and the JSON Schemas

tests.description: Unit tests for validation, routing, loading, the envelope and the CLI against an example hive
Schema tests compare regardless of line endings, so they pass on Windows
